notablePrerequisites:
A Forest in your graveyard.
Tanuki Transplanter attached to Erinis.
Erinis and Orcish Lumberjack do not have summoning sickness.
Erinis cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Erinis as an attacker.
Erinis and Tanuki Transplanter each trigger.
Resolve Erinis's trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Tanuki Transplanter's trigger, adding {G}{G}{G} that is not lost until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Erinis.
In your postcombat main phase, activate Orcish Lumberjack by tapping it and sacrificing a Forest, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and generating an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.
